topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
subtopic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: In a brokerage account, you will generally make your own investment decisions.
question: Misconception: When I open a brokerage account, my broker automatically gets to make investment decisions for me.
answer: Generally, you make your own investment decisions in a brokerage account. A broker can receive discretionary authority only in certain situations, and granting that authority requires written legal authorization.
